cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C5: defining anionic is the alkyl-sulfate-type Sodium Coco-Sulfate@2, buffered by four prominent buffers (Lauryl Glucoside@3, Coco-Glucoside@4 nonionic glucosides; Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate@8, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate@11 mild anionics), no reinforcing strong anionic. Well above the two-buffer requirement. Formula-only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (several light routes): three hydrolyzed proteins (Corn@13, Wheat@14, Soy@15), the cationic conditioning surfactant PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate@19, Arginine@10 and Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice@6. No silicone, cationic polymer, payload_lipid, pearlizer or deliberate C2 humectant (aloe juice is excluded from the C2 humectant element), so C2 is not met. Counter-signal: all routes are light and the cationic sits just before the preservatives; low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (protein film and a cationic conditioner).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light routes: three hydrolyzed proteins after salt, acid and ferments, and a cationic arginate ester just before the preservatives; no silicone, cationic polymer, payload_lipid or film former; a C5 sulfate chassis with four buffers gives moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): both families are late and light (hydrolyzed proteins @13-15, a non-polymeric cationic surfactant @19 one place before the W-line @20), so their combined residue plausibly stays below noticeable against a moderate reset.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W2 boundary; the cationic arginate's deposition is not characterized in this standard (family assignment by chemistry).
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6): two light, late families against moderate reset; W2 reason recorded; no W-RICH.
